text:
Sam: Quick heads up — prepping new tenant (comet) in ap-northeast-3. Need p5/p4d/g5 entitlement bump + ENI/SNAT/EIP planning. Starting with 8 p5s, will ramp to 24 after validation.
Maria: Thanks. Can you confirm subaccount and billing org? We need that for AWS quota request form.
Sam: org=comet-team, billing account ID 987654321000. Region ap-northeast-3. Expected steady-state: 24 p5, 12 p4d, 40 g5 across a few AZs.
Kai: Networking note — ap-northeast-3 has lower ENI default in our org. We'll want +200 ENI and +50 Elastic IPs to be safe. Also need to plan NATGW SNAT pool for outbound IPs (source NAT capacity).
Ashley: Cost heads-up: p5s are ~8.5$/hr each on demand. If we're reserving dedicated capacity we'll negotiate reserved pricing — otherwise this could spike billing during validation.
Sam: Understood. For initial request I'll ask AWS for quota increases and a warm-up for capacity. Need a ticket template — can someone paste the exact fields?
CloudOps: I'll open the formal support case. Use this payload in the support ticket: ```
Region: ap-northeast-3
Account: 987654321000 (comet-team)
Requested resources:
  - p5 instances: Increase from 0 -> 24
  - p4d instances: Increase from 0 -> 12
  - g5 instances: Increase from 0 -> 40
  - ENIs: Increase by 200
  - Elastic IPs: Increase by 50
Reason: Onboarding Redwood Dedicated pilot for latency-sensitive inference. Will use burst and warmup scheduling over 2 weeks.
Priority: High
Contact: Maria (infra@redwood.ai)
AWS console link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home?region=ap-northeast-3
``` 
Maria: Add the expected instance families and the expected peak concurrent vCPU/GPU counts if you can — support sometimes asks for sustained usage patterns.
Sam: Quick sample numbers: peak GPUs 24 (p5) + 12 (p4d) + 40 (g5) = 76 GPUs. Peak vCPU approx 9k across instances. We'll attach a spreadsheet.
InfraBot: Automated check: region ap-northeast-3 currently shows 0 p5, 0 p4d, 2 g5 in our org. ENI headroom: 80 available. Recommend increases above requested for safety.
Kai: Also request an AZ-spread allowance / multi-AZ placement and ask AWS to reserve capacity if possible for p5s during our onboarding window (2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-24).
CloudOps: Opening support case now. I'll CC @Maria and include the billing contact. Expected AWS case ID: 1234567890. Will post updates here.
Sam: Thanks. Also can we pre-configure an autoscaling warm pool and a canary job to smoke-test kernels? Want to validate GPU kernel availability once instances land.
Maria: Yes — infra runbook: start 2 p5 in warm pool per AZ, run kernel-bench and end-to-end inference test. If metrics pass, scale to 8/az.
Ashley: Make sure to enable cost tags: project=comet, environment=pilot, owner=sam — will help with chargeback and monitor spend.
CloudOps: Case created: AWS Support #1234567890 — ETA 48-72h for quota response. Ticket includes ENI and EIP increases, and request for AZ-spread capacity hold.
Sam: Nice. I'll prepare the attachment (workload profile + expected schedule) and drop it in the ticket.
Kai: FYI — if AWS pushes back on ENIs, fallback is to request larger subnets for the VPC and ask for per-instance ENI limits. Also consider using NAT Gateway scaling patterns to minimize EIP needs.
Maria: After case resolves, I'll kick off the preflight checklist and post the provisioning playbook here.
Sam: Perfect. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
InfraBot: Reminder scheduled: follow up on AWS Support #1234567890 in 72h.
